DravenViz slice 1: visual reference review

Decision: pending for all 14 candidates. Nothing here is approved. Under design D4 only the owner approves a baseline; until then the visual tests fail with “pending owner review” by design. Reply per candidate id: “approve <id>” or “changes requested on <id>: …”.

Please look at these first

  • R29, half-clipped stroke at a fit-domain plot edge. A line or marker at the lowest or highest value of a fit domain can be cut in half by the plot boundary. Candidates where a value sits on the domain edge: line-measured-zero@print, line-estimated-monotone@light, line-estimated-monotone@print, line-category-labels-wrap@print, line-category-labels-rotate@print, line-category-labels-thin@print. line-weekly-flow was checked too: its domain is include-zero and none of its values lies on an edge, so it is not flagged, but its first points are on the page for you to confirm.
  • Actual vs estimated dashes in grayscale (print theme). Do the solid and dashed patterns stay distinguishable when printed without colour? line-estimated-monotone@print.
  • R28, legend quality text length. The legend draws each quality’s meaning after its label; is it too long or crowded? line-weekly-flow@light, line-weekly-flow@dark, line-weekly-flow@print, line-estimated-monotone@light, line-estimated-monotone@print.

Candidates

  • line-weekly-flow@light (R28)
  • line-weekly-flow@dark (R28)
  • line-weekly-flow@print (R28)
  • line-thinned-annotation@print
  • line-singleton@print
  • line-all-equal@print
  • line-measured-zero@print (R29)
  • line-all-missing@print
  • line-fixed-domain-clipped@print
  • line-estimated-monotone@light (R29, R28)
  • line-estimated-monotone@print (R29, DASH, R28)
  • line-category-labels-wrap@print (R29)
  • line-category-labels-rotate@print (R29)
  • line-category-labels-thin@print (R29)

Each card shows the browser render, the standalone SVG and (print theme, fixtures in report-slice1) the crop from the real DravenPDF PDF, so clipping indicators, estimated dashes and monotone curves can be compared in all three outputs. The data table is the accessible table of the same spec.
